HIFI is a stablecoin infrastructure company building technology for the next-generation of financial products. We build tools for payments and tokenized money products across money movement, cards, and capital markets. **About the Team**

HIFI's engineering team builds the payments infrastructure that fintechs and financial institutions use to move money on stablecoin rails. The team owns the APIs, ledger, and on-chain systems behind every payment HIFI processes, and works closely with product and compliance to make sure that infrastructure is reliable, secure, and ready for regulated use. As HIFI's volume grows and more institutions build on our platform, this team will decide how stablecoin payments hold up at the scale and standard that traditional financial infrastructure is held to.

As a
**Blockchain Engineer**
at HIFI you will help own on-chain systems day to day. You'll build and maintain the integrations, smart contracts, and wallet infrastructure that connect HIFI's payments products to the chains and stablecoins we support. This is a hands-on role with real ownership: you'll design how funds move and settle on-chain, work with the rest of engineering to connect those flows to our ledger and APIs, and partner with compliance on controls like wallet screening and transaction monitoring. You'll also be the person the team relies on to judge when a new chain or protocol is ready for production use.

* Wallet infrastructure, including key management, transaction signing, and orchestration across custodial and programmatic wallets.
* Onchain transaction handling across EVM chains and the other networks we support, including gas, nonce management, and retries.
* Stablecoin minting, burning, and settlement logic that connects USDC and other stablecoins to fiat rails for our on-ramp and off-ramp products.
* Integrations with centralized and decentralized exchanges for swaps and liquidity routing, and cross-chain bridging between networks.
* A double-entry ledger that keeps onchain balances, banking partners, and customer accounts in sync, with automated reconciliation.
* Event listeners, confirmation tracking, and webhooks that give our platform and customers real-time visibility into onchain activity.
* Idempotent transaction pipelines with failure recovery and screening hooks, so money moves correctly even when something goes wrong.

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 1 to 2 years building blockchain systems in production.

* You build financial systems with reconciliation and audit trails by default.
* You communicate clearly in code review and in writing.

* Familiarity with traditional money movement, including ACH, wires, and how funds settle between banks and processors.
* Early-stage startup experience building and running a system from scratch.

Every payment HIFI processes eventually settles on-chain, and the institutions behind those payments expect them to work as reliably as a wire or an ACH transfer. This is a chance to build the on-chain systems that hold stablecoin payments to that standard, and to shape how regulated money moves on public blockchains while that infrastructure is still being defined.

Team Introduction:
  
  
Global E-Commerce (TikTok Shop) is one of TikTok's fastest-growing businesses and a core driver of the company's revenue growth. Our Global E-Commerce Content Recommendation team owns the end-to-end recommendation stack for e-commerce video and image-text content on TikTok worldwide — retrieval, ranking, and multi-queue blending; supply ecosystem and cold start; and the browsing-to-purchase experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  
  
We believe recommendation is being rewritten in the compute era. ID-based collaborative filtering and supervised learning built today's systems and still run most of the industry — but their returns are diminishing, and we are betting the next order of magnitude on rebuilding the stack on LLM foundations. Our ambition is to build the most advanced recommendation system in the world, and the next generation after that.
  
  
We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
  
  
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

**Responsibilities:**
You will help build — and rewrite — an industrial recommendation system serving a billion-scale user base across short-video, livestream, and product scenarios, covering retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and blending end to end. Every iteration ships to production and directly moves user experience and GMV.
  
  

* Scale recommendation models like LLMs. Push ranking models from hundreds of millions to billions of parameters and chart the scaling laws of recommendation: behavior-corpus pretraining; multi-scenario, multi-task, multi-stage joint training; ultra-long behavior-sequence modeling (10K+ events) with KV caching, sequence compression, user/generation (U-G) disaggregated serving, speculative decoding, and dynamic batching — raising MFU while holding a strict millisecond latency budget.
* Build one-stage generative retrieval. Reframe retrieval as generation: tokenize the item space into semantic IDs (RQ-VAE / SID) and train autoregressive models, grounded in MLLM semantics, to generate what a user wants next — collapsing the traditional "multi-channel retrieval + ranking" funnel into a single generative stage. The open problems span the full stack: item tokenizers that balance semantic content against collaborative signal, and SIDs that stay stable while millions of new items arrive daily; post-training the generator directly on live user feedback (preference optimization, GRPO-style RL); and decoding under a millisecond budget — beam search, decoding constrained to the valid item space, and test-time scaling that trades inference compute for better recommendations. The prize is a system freed from its path dependence on ID memorization, where cold-start generalization comes from semantics rather than impression history.
* Inject world knowledge.
